emotional_tone: Authoritative, Precise, Scholarly, and Effortlessly Modern. An anti-default, premium aesthetic.
tech_stack_guidance: PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap 5, Vanilla CSS/JS. Avoid using standard Bootstrap aesthetics. Override soft shadows and default primary colors. Rely heavily on custom utility classes, sharp borders, and sophisticated typography.

headings.style: Elegant, tight letter-spacing, highly readable but classic.

body.style: Clean, geometric, sterile-mono feel for maximum contrast against the serif headers.

scale.h1: 4rem (64px) - Use tight line-height (1.1) and tight tracking.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento-style grids for features and services. Use Bootstrap rows/cols but with gap-4 or gap-5. Avoid 100% full-width equal columns if possible—mix col-md-8 and col-md-4 for asymmetry.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous. Multiply standard Bootstrap padding by 2. Use 'py-5' and custom 'py-6' (e.g., 6rem) for sections.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid #E0E0E0 or #1A1A1A depending on contrast. Sharp corners (border-radius: 0 or max 2px).

component_guidelines.buttons: Square or 2px rounded corners. Primary button: bg-dark (#1A1A1A) text-white. Hover state: bg-brand (#8C1D18). Thick 1px borders. Add 'data-testid' to all buttons.
component_guidelines.cards_services: Flat rectangular blocks. border: 1px solid #E0E0E0. background: #FFFFFF. NO box-shadow. On hover, apply a subtle -translate-y transition and change border color to #1A1A1A.
component_guidelines.hero_section: Asymmetric layout. Left: Massive H1 typography, narrow column. Right: Overlapping image (hero_academic_books) with a slight offset bento-box. Max overlay opacity bg-black/30 if text is on image.
component_guidelines.navigation: Solid background (#FAFAFA) with a 1px bottom border. No deep drop shadows. Links in IBM Plex Sans, clean and small.
component_guidelines.accordion_faq: Override default Bootstrap accordion. Remove borders between items, just use a 1px solid bottom border per item. No background color on active state. Use a simple + / - icon.
component_guidelines.order_tracking: Vertical timeline. Use a left-aligned thick 2px line (#E0E0E0). Nodes are sharp squares (not circles) in #1A1A1A. Active nodes in #8C1D18.
component_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements, links, forms, and buttons MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-consultation-btn').

hero_main.description: Elegant academic study room, hardbound books, scholarly manuscript.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract crisp white paper pages, architectural shadows.

library_academic.description: Grand academic library interior with ornate railings.

books_rack.description: Books on a rack, academic reading.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set up a global custom CSS file/block that imports the Google Fonts and overrides Bootstrap's root variables (--bs-primary, --bs-body-font-family, etc.). 2. Apply 'Cormorant Garamond' to all h1-h6 tags. Apply 'IBM Plex Sans' to the body. 3. Strip out default Bootstrap shadows (.shadow) and rounded corners (.rounded) for a crisp, high-end editorial look. 4. Use the provided image URLs exclusively for visual placeholders—do not use generic dummyimage.com placeholders. 5. Implement the bento-box grid strategy where possible using Bootstrap's grid system combined with custom gaps. 6. Ensure every clickable element has a descriptive data-testid.
